decisions.reason: The existing About-page update removes Big Block references from its new mechanics fields but leaves older copy fields describing Big Block and $6,000 prizes; those fields must be replaced with Small-Block-only copy.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Marcus, please remove the big blocks and redirect that extra $8 to me. The new breakdown should be:
$30 purchase, $12 to me, $10 to the affiliate, and $8 to the block prize pool.

That should improve my bottom line without materially affecting sales, while also making the game mechanics and marketing simpler.

An even arrangement between me and each community member, together with an equal opportunity to win the continuing $900 prizes, feels consistent with the project's ethos.

value_updates.prize_collection_copy: Prize collection is automatic: winners receive $900 directly in their wallet and check the dashboard or email for notification; omit one-click redemption-control wording.
value_updates.prize_claim_copy: Prize winners receive $900 automatically in their wallet; the About page must not present a visible or one-click redemption control.
value_updates.prize_mechanics_content: Remove Big Block ticket, draw, and $6,000-prize references from the About page. Describe only the continuing $900 Small Block prizes, with Chainlink VRF selecting winners for the remaining draw.
value_updates.prize_mechanics_copy: Remove all Big Block references from the About page and describe only Small Block tickets and the continuing $900 prizes.

decisions.reason: Removing Big Block prizes and changing the purchase allocation does not alter Transak provider selection, fiat methods, wallet provisioning, or mint destination.
The NFT token serial remains the referral code and its display locations are unaffected by removal of the Big Block prize mechanism.
Transactional email delivery and winner notification by email remain required for the continuing Small Block prizes; no stored email-delivery attribute requires modification.
The source decision does not change one-time email authentication or dashboard access for referrals, tickets, and continuing prizes.
SIWE authentication and Transak-created-wallet dashboard access remain valid independently of which prize blocks exist.
The candidate stores only the generic automatic-wallet-transfer payout mode, which remains valid for the continuing $900 prizes.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already completely narrows Chainlink VRF applicability from Small and Big Block draws to Small Block draws only.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already records the $12 founder share, $10 affiliate commission, $8 prize-pool share, and Small-Block-only pool destination.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes the obsolete big_block_ticket_counter_visible key while retaining the continuing Small Block counter.
The rule that active prize tickets follow the NFT remains valid for the remaining Small Block tickets and does not encode a Big-Block-specific attribute.
The source explicitly retains the $10 affiliate allocation, so the coded-referral commission amount, recipient, trigger, and automatic payout behavior remain unchanged.
